name: inhouse-lol
description: Gerenciador de custom games 5x5 semanais de League of Legends: draft com roles, Fearless Draft em MD3 e estatisticas.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace client
